title: Classic Banff Lake Louise Johnston Canyon and Emerald Lake Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the majestic Canadian Rockies on the Classic Banff and Lake Louise Explorer tour. This full-day adventure showcases stunning mountain landscapes and the iconic turquoise waters of Lake Louis. With opportunities for optional hikes and guided sightseeing, nature lovers and photographers can capture the beauty of Emerald Lake and the Natural Bridge. Enjoy free time to explore the charming town of Banff, making this a perfect blend of adventure and relaxation amidst the breathtaking wilderness.

 Full-day tour from 7 AM to 7 PM, covering major highlights
 Visit Lake Louise, Emerald Lake, and Banff Town
 Comfortable transportation and park fees included
 Ideal for nature enthusiasts and photography lovers
